description: Estimate the total price to frame an artwork of given dimensions in a chosen frame profile.

frameProfileId.description: The id of a frame profile, as returned by framing.list-frame-profiles.

name: framing_estimate-frame-price

currency.description: ISO currency code for the estimate (e.g. RON).

estimatedPrice.description: Estimated total cost to frame the artwork. Absent when the profile has no price data configured.
